scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-monitor/web && npm run build -w @ai-monitor/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run start:dev -w @ai-monitor/server" "npm run dev -w @ai-monitor/web"
scripts.test: node --test scripts/desktop-toolchain.spec.mjs plugins/openclaw-ai-monitor-replies/index.spec.mjs && npm run test -w @ai-monitor/server && npm run test -w @ai-monitor/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ai-monitor/server && npm run typecheck -w @ai-monitor/web
